text:
dina: heads-up 1: I'm iterating on a 'chain bill' panel for the console . Purpose: expose per-hop token usage, cache delta, and per-model unit econ for multi-model invocations. want ops/telemetry + UX input.
noah: sounds useful. clarify: chain = single invocation graph (client request + any chained model calls)?
dina: yes. example: user -> embed-1 -> rerank-2 -> generate-3. we should show per-hop sku, tokens_in/out, cache saves, and a net cost column.
priya: telemetry ask: need model_sku, chain_uuid, hop_index, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cache_hit, cache_saved_tokens, precision_label, fallback_flag, route_tag, tenant_id. also redact any raw prompt text before export.
sam: agree on fields. sampling: propose 0.5% full-event sampling (includes token arrays and hop list) + always emit aggregated summary per invocation: {tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_saved_tokens, duration_ms}. that keeps heavy data rare.
noah: ops: for sampled events we should partition by date/tenant/route and gzip newline-delimited json to S3. retention: keep raw samples 21d, daily rollups forever. this reduces storage compared to keeping 30d.
dina: i want a canary mode in the UI: pick a routing delta (e.g., default reranker -> cheaper reranker-v2) and simulate cost impact by replaying sampled chains. show mean, p50, p90, and a bootstrap CI. can we compute that from samples?
sam: yes. if we attach route_tag and candidate_sku metadata to samples, we can do Monte Carlo replays. we'll need enough samples per route; UI should show sample count and signal quality (low/medium/high).
priya: also add a flag for cross-tenant shared cache. attribution rule question: if a cache hit returns a value seeded by a different route, who gets the credit? i prefer attributing saved tokens to the route that caused the original write, and separately show "beneficiary" routes in the panel. makes chargeback transparent.
noah: technical detail: emit separate cache events: {event: "cache_write", chain_uuid, cache_key_hash, saved_tokens, origin_route, tenant_id} and {event: "cache_hit", chain_uuid, cache_key_hash, served_to_route}. analytics joins on cache_key_hash windowed by TTL. avoids keeping router logic complex.
dina: good. priya: security/privacy: ensure cache_key_hash is salted per-tenant or truncated to avoid leaking prompt fingerprints.
sam: agreed. we'll include salted_hash and also an opt-out for customers.
ingest-bot: ingest-estimate: +9% ingress at 0.5% sampling with full schema. storage estimate: +1.7% monthly with 21d TTL on samples.
dina: thanks ingest-bot. UX note: the panel should default to daily aggregates and allow drill-in to sampled invocation examples (anonymized). canary UI: slider for traffic % + run-time preview of cost change and CI. also a "why" column linking to model unit pricing and quantization impact.
noah: implementation plan: sam PR for schema + example payloads, i'll open infra ticket for S3 partitions and ingest quota, priya to outline redaction and hashing guidelines, dina will produce a quick mock and product brief.
sam: i'll attach a sample payload here in the PR: e.g.,
```
{ "event":"invocation_summary", "chain_uuid":"c-789", "tenant_id":"acme", "route":"search", "hops":[{"hop_index":0,"sku":"embed-2b-q4","in":32,"out":64,"cache_hit":false},{"hop_index":1,"sku":"rerank-1b-fp16","in":64,"out":6,"cache_hit":true}], "tokens_in":96, "tokens_out":70, "cache_saved_tokens":58, "duration_ms":412 }
{ "event":"cache_write", "chain_uuid":"c-789", "cache_key_hash":"h_abc123_salted", "saved_tokens":58, "origin_route":"search" }
```
dina: perfect. let's sync tomorrow at 10 for a quick readout. thanks! :rocket:
